citations.citation: For the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which thousands of atoms are held in a magic-wavelength lattice and interrogated free of Doppler, recoil and first-order light shifts, bringing optical frequency standards to the 10^-18 level

for the invention and realisation of the optical lattice clock, in which many atoms are interrogated in a magic-wavelength lattice, bringing the measurement of time to the 10^-18 level
for the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which many atoms are interrogated in a magic-wavelength lattice, bringing optical frequency standards to the 1e-18 regime

for the invention and realisation of the optical lattice clock, in which thousands of atoms trapped at a magic wavelength are interrogated free of first-order light shift and motional broadening, bringing optical frequency standards to the 10^-18 level

for the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which many atoms are interrogated at a magic wavelength free of first-order light shift and motional broadening, taking optical frequency standards to the 10^-18 level

for the invention and development of the optical lattice clock, in which many atoms trapped at a magic wavelength are interrogated free of Doppler and recoil shifts, bringing atomic timekeeping to the 10^-18 level
